Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first search regarding George II's mother), the WebSurfer incorrectly extracted "Princess Christiane Henriette of Nassau-Siegen" as the mother from the search snippet. This is factually incorrect; the snippets visible in the conversation clearly state that George II's mother was "Princess Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen." The WebSurfer failed to accurately read the visible text in the viewport, which explicitly mentioned Augusta of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen, instead hallucinating a different name (Christiane Henriette of Nassau-Siegen) that likely appeared in a different context or was a misinterpretation of the search results. This initial error created confusion and required multiple subsequent steps to correct the record.
